verdict.rationale: Penpot documents dev-handoff via code inspection (CSS/HTML/SVG/JSON matching design) and design tokens, plus MCP-driven AI workflows where 'design is expressed as code' so agents can read design files and produce artifacts. However, this is closer to Figma-style 'inspect code' rather than confirmed component-to-code or codegen output verified as production-shippable, and no community/hands-on evidence validates the quality or usability of exported code for real projects. Missing for 10: independent verification that exported/AI-generated code is actually shippable in production, concrete examples of component-to-code mapping tooling, and community confirmation of code-handoff quality (only UI/performance feedback exists, not code-export feedback).
